notes: Book title is the source metadata Text field. The README describes 370 hymns.
Ekegusii (Gusii) has no ISO 639-1 code; guz is its ISO 639-3 code.

Two records are numbered 86. The first, "'S'Omogoko Natomokerere", is retained. The second is titled "(a) Ebisio Amang`ana Y`enkoro", a lettered sub-hymn (86a); its lyrics match no other record and every number 1–370 already has a record, so it is not another number's hymn. Numeric identities cannot represent 86a without renumbering, so it is withheld and disclosed.
